tagline: Calm explainers that do the maths on screen: your face in a framed card, white ledger rows that land on every number, the claim crossed out and the real figure revealed.
readiness_note: Case-file format needs 15-25 of your own monochrome stills per episode; without them it uses drawn object plates.

captions: Ledger inset hook: the first row builds and its value chip lands on the spoken number
Face-bottom calculator: two options race on one axis as the year slider moves
Maroon traps theme: the claimed value is struck and the real figure pops beside it
